cards.name: PageHeader
cards.subtitle: Two-line display title over a rule
cards.summary: The subpage title: a hairline rule, then a two-line display heading with the second line in the accent red.

cards.name: Principles
cards.subtitle: Editorial first, structure visible, accent with restraint, warm precision
cards.summary: The four principles as a numbered specimen section: index, title, and a grid of short articles.

cards.name: Typography
cards.subtitle: Söhne scale from mega numeral to microcopy
cards.summary: Type does most of the personality work. Scale changes can be bold, but weight, spacing, and line length stay disciplined.

cards.name: Links
cards.subtitle: Inline, arrow and button links
cards.summary: Links do most of the work. Buttons are used sparingly, when an action deserves emphasis.

cards.name: Color
cards.subtitle: Roles first, dark then light
cards.summary: Color is assigned a job before it's assigned a value. Dark mode first; light mode is an alternate reading environment, not a separate design.

cards.name: Grid
cards.subtitle: 12 columns, 40px gutters, 1268px max
cards.summary: The grid keeps the left rail, reading column, and wider editorial blocks in deliberate relation to each other.

cards.name: Spacing
cards.subtitle: 8 to 72px steps, 40px rhythm
cards.summary: Spacing is generous by default: strong vertical breaks and clean internal grouping.

cards.name: Patterns
cards.subtitle: Rails, breakpoints, surfaces, measure
cards.summary: Repeated patterns carry navigation, hierarchy, and state without adding extra explanation.

cards.name: Tokens
cards.subtitle: Docs and machine-readable tokens
cards.summary: The same system, exported for humans and machines: the spec and the W3C design tokens file.

cards.name: SiteFooter
cards.subtitle: Name, social icons, site and case-study links
cards.summary: The site footer: name and role, social icon links, utility links, and columns of site and case-study links.
